description: Lists the site's pages and folders on a branch: each page's address, file and whether it has a variable part (collection pages and other :slug routes), each folder (explicit or from page addresses and collection URL folders) with its name, folder page, page count and the collections whose items live in it, and how Xodia can change pages on this site. Read it before adding or moving pages. Reads only.
